[SWS_DM_00278] Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation in case of Internal Processing
⌈
On Cancellation of a Diagnostic Conversation in case a
diagnostic request is currently processed on this protocol internally within the Di-
agnostic Server instance, the Diagnostic Server instance shall abort
started activity as far as possible.
